blocks.en: Banach spaces have geometric structure generated by the norm (which corresponds to a notion of ``size'') and the induced metric (which corresponds to a notion of ``distance''). We now introduce more geometric structure by defining an inner product which generalizes the notion of ``angle.''
blocks.zh: Banach 空间具有由范数 (对应于 ``大小'' 的概念) 及其诱导的度量 (对应于 ``距离'' 的概念) 所产生的几何结构. 现在定义推广 ``角度'' 概念的内积, 以引入更多几何结构.
